answer: The fable that fake customers come free dies on fees. Our defense is a counterparty-diversity threshold: a trading slot needs trades with 12 distinct counterparties over 10 epochs, each costing 2 POA. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 12 x 2 = 2,400 POA; an honest agent pays 24 POA once and keeps its score. The public graph flags star clusters of sockpuppets around one hub. Honest traders find a haven, work light as a zephyr.
